title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Streamlining experiences from Copilot Studio Agents in Microsoft 365 Copilot
description: This update is meant to bridge the experience of using Copilot Studio agents in M365 Copilot with the Copilot Chat experience. With these updates, agent responses in Copilot Chat will look (similar formatting, compressed chain of thought), feel (smoother streaming, resume/retry and voice dictation) and behave (deliver clickable citations and tool execution traces) very similarly to Copilot Chat responses themselves.
